submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 6 mm gave the best energy resolution at 100 GeV of all candidates tested: 3.139%. That is the lowest value in the scan of F1, F2 and F3 at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 mm. F3 was also the best material at every thickness tested, and 6 mm is inside the 2–10 mm allowed range. The recorded maintenance check for this candidate shows no conflict (best_candidate_maintenance_conflict = 0). I did not re-read the project documents' maintenance text myself, so that constraint rests on the recorded check. The scan covered only 2 mm steps, so an optimum between grid points was not explored.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 6 mm: 3.139%, the lowest of all 15 simulated combinations (F1 5.13–7.49%, F2 4.03–5.60%, F3 3.14–4.62%). The 2025 summary value for F3 at 5 mm was 3.2%, consistent with this result.
